study.title: Cluster of climatic and pollutant characteristics increases admissions for acute myocardial infarction: Analysis of 30,423 patients in the metropolitan area of Sao Paulo

published_design.geography: 39 municipalities of the Sao Paulo metropolitan region
published_design.outcome: Daily acute myocardial infarction admissions from DATASUS, ICD-10 I21
published_design.analysis: Hierarchical clustering of daily environmental inputs, followed by comparison of daily admissions and in-hospital mortality across three clusters.
published_design.published_result: The high-temperature-variation, low-humidity, high-pollution cluster had 30.5 daily MI admissions (IQR 25.0-36.0), reported as a 9% increase.
